\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[paperwidth=400pt,paperheight=170pt,textwidth=340pt,textheight=50pt,top=30pt,left=30pt]{geometry}
\setlength\columnsep{20pt}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newif\ifBoundaryStrict
\BoundaryStricttrue
\newcount\PFormatted
\newwrite\PNodes
\newwrite\PEffects
\immediate\openout\PNodes=\jobname.nodes
\immediate\openout\PEffects=\jobname.effects
\let\PName\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
 \global\advance\PFormatted by1
 \protected@write\PNodes{}{ENTRY #1}\PName{#1}}
\def\PSide{}
\def\PFail#1{\PackageError{boundary-test}{#1}{Boundary columns must be unique and retain their next-entry style.}}
% Phase 8B observer: project stored owners only for frozen depth assertions.
% Legacy and owner-list sources run this same fixture without compatibility code.
\newif\ifPOwnerLists
\ifdefined\dte@foreach@owner\POwnerListstrue\else\POwnerListsfalse\fi
\def\PProject#1{%
  \edef\PRaw{#1}%
  \ifPOwnerLists
    \let\PActual\@empty
    \@for\PItem:=\PRaw\do{%
      \edef\PDepth{\dte@eget{\PItem}{d}}%
      \ifx\PActual\@empty
        \let\PActual\PDepth
      \else
        \edef\PActual{\PActual,\PDepth}%
      \fi}%
  \else
    \let\PActual\PRaw
  \fi}
\def\PCheckStoredOwners#1{%
  \ifPOwnerLists
    \@for\PItem:=\PRaw\do{%
      \edef\PDepth{\dte@eget{\PItem}{d}}%
      \ifcsname POwner@#1@\PDepth\endcsname
        \ifnum\PItem=\csname POwner@#1@\PDepth\endcsname\relax
        \else\PFail{Wrong stored boundary owner after #1 at depth \PDepth}\fi
      \else\PFail{Unexpected stored boundary owner after #1}\fi}%
  \fi}
\tikzset{p4 owner/.code={%
 \ifx\PSide\@empty\else
   \ifBoundaryStrict
     \edef\PSeenName{PSeen@\pgfpictureid @\PSide @\the\dte@k}%
     \ifcsname\PSeenName\endcsname\PFail{Repeated \PSide\space boundary depth \the\dte@k}\fi
     \expandafter\gdef\csname\PSeenName\endcsname{1}%
     \ifcsname POwner@\PCutIndex @\the\dte@k\endcsname
       \ifnum#1=\csname POwner@\PCutIndex @\the\dte@k\endcsname\relax\else\PFail{Wrong style owner}\fi
     \else\PFail{Unexpected boundary column}\fi
   \fi
   \protected@write\PEffects{}{PAINT \PSide/\the\dte@piecenum/\PCutIndex/\the\dte@k/#1}%
 \fi}}
% Recover the same cut index from the enduring boundary record, locally.
\ifPOwnerLists
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\dte@foreach@owner\dte@prevbk\dte@draw@topcolumn}
    {\def\PSide{top}%
     \edef\PCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\numexpr\dte@piecenum-1\relax}}%
     \dte@foreach@owner\dte@prevbk\dte@draw@topcolumn}
    {}{\PFail{Cannot observe top boundary}}
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\dte@foreach@owner\dte@curbk\dte@draw@bottomcolumn}
    {\def\PSide{bottom}%
     \edef\PCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\dte@piecenum}}%
     \dte@foreach@owner\dte@curbk\dte@draw@bottomcolumn}
    {}{\PFail{Cannot observe bottom boundary}}
\else
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@prevbk\do}
    {\def\PSide{top}%
     \edef\PCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\numexpr\dte@piecenum-1\relax}}%
     \@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@prevbk\do}
    {}{\PFail{Cannot observe top boundary}}
  \patchcmd{\dte@drawpiece}{\@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@curbk\do}
    {\def\PSide{bottom}%
     \edef\PCutIndex{\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@\the\dte@piecenum}}%
     \@for\dte@extlvl:=\dte@curbk\do}
    {}{\PFail{Cannot observe bottom boundary}}
\fi
\let\PStore\dte@store@breaklines
\def\dte@store@breaklines#1#2{%
 \PStore{#1}{#2}%
 \expandafter\gdef\csname PCut@#1\endcsname{1}%
 \ifBoundaryStrict
   \PProject{\dte@safeget{dte@breaklines@#2}}%
   \PCheckStoredOwners{#1}%
   \expandafter\let\expandafter\PExpected\csname PList@#1\endcsname
   \ifx\PActual\PExpected\else\PFail{Wrong complete boundary list after #1}\fi
 \fi}
\let\PEntry\dte@render@entry
\def\dte@render@entry#1{%
 \ifcsname PHardCut@#1\endcsname\penalty-10000\relax\fi
 \PEntry{#1}}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@1\endcsname{0}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@1@0\endcsname{2}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@2\endcsname{0,1}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@2@0\endcsname{5}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@2@1\endcsname{3}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@3\endcsname{1}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@3@1\endcsname{4}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@4\endcsname{}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@5\endcsname{0,1}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@5@0\endcsname{7}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@5@1\endcsname{6}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@6\endcsname{}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@7\endcsname{0}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@7@0\endcsname{8}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@8\endcsname{0}
\expandafter\def\csname POwner@8@0\endcsname{9}
\expandafter\def\csname PList@9\endcsname{}
\expandafter\def\csname PHardCut@2\endcsname{1}
\expandafter\def\csname PHardCut@3\endcsname{1}
\expandafter\def\csname PHardCut@5\endcsname{1}
\expandafter\def\csname PHardCut@6\endcsname{1}
\expandafter\def\csname PHardCut@7\endcsname{1}
\expandafter\def\csname PHardCut@8\endcsname{1}
\expandafter\def\csname PHardCut@9\endcsname{1}
\AtEndDocument{%
 \ifnum\PFormatted=9\relax\else\PFail{Formatter count changed}\fi
 \ifdte@needrerun
  \typeout{P4-COVERAGE-PENDING}%
 \else
  \@for\PCut:=1,2,4,5,6,7,8\do{%
    \ifcsname PCut@\PCut\endcsname\else\PFail{Required transition not split after \PCut}\fi}%
  \typeout{P4-BOUNDARIES-PASSED}%
 \fi
 \typeout{P4-FORMATTED=\the\PFormatted}}
\makeatother
